name: robots/robotis-git__turtlebot3_simulations
title: ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 fake simulation node
intro: ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 fake simulation node, adapted from robotis-git/turtlebot3_simulations. It reads `odom_pose`, `odom_twist`, `wheel_velocity`, `read_odometry` and 1 more; runs `publish_velocity`. `publish_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist to the upstream /cmd_vel subscription; the fake node consumes only linear.x and angular.z. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. /cmd_vel is also a physical TurtleBot3 command topic, so this action is R2. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
